title: Cross-functional quarterly playbook for Hosted API & Model Catalog cadence
creator: Avery Lin
description: Create a repeatable, cross-functional quarterly planning playbook that aligns Hosted API release windows with Model Catalog rotations. Purpose: reduce last-minute roll conflicts, codify canary/rollback gates, and give Eng/Design/PM a single source-of-truth for cadence decisions. This ticket scopes the playbook doc, rollout templates, required dashboards, and a risk/mitigation heatmap for Q1 planning and the next two quarters.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook draft published and reviewed by Eng, Design, and SRE
Canary run template (percent steps, duration, metrics, rollback) created and stored in Console runbook
Three dashboards added to Console: model-health, latency-cost-breakdown, regression-alerts
Dependency matrix with owners for all model rotations and hosted endpoint releases published
Sign-off from PM lead and Runtime eng manager for operational gates
comments: 2025-01-10 - Sync: Met with Runtime and Infra to map capacity windows; infra flagged potential GPU maintenance on 2025-02-15 impacting canary capacity
2025-01-13 - Decision: Use staged canary (1%, 5%, 25%, 100%) with minimum 24h observation at each step for new model variants that change tokenizer or quantization path
2025-01-15 - Trade-off noted: faster rotation cadence reduces stale models but increases ops load; proposal adds a 'fast-track' lane for security or regulatory patches
2025-01-17 - Review feedback from Design: include a user-facing deprecation notice template and migration checklist for SDK breaking changes
2025-01-20 - Action: PM to coordinate tabletop drill on rollback procedures during Cycle planning week
next_steps: Workshop with SRE on alert thresholds and automated rollback triggers (owner: Elena Park, due: 2025-01-24)
Prototype canary run using a low-risk model variant in staging to validate observability queries (owner: Runtime team, due: 2025-01-28)
Draft user deprecation notice and SDK migration guide (owner: Developer Experience, due: 2025-02-05)
Populate dependency matrix and confirm owners for all listed model rotations (owner: PM roster, due: 2025-02-10)
risk_heatmap: Capacity contention during overlapping canaries - mitigation: enforce release windows and reserve burst pool (owner: Infra)
Regression in output quality after quantization changes - mitigation: must-gate with eval suite and rollback threshold of quality drop > 3 BLEU-equivalent or model-specific metric (owner: Applied ML)
SDK breaking changes disrupt downstream integrations - mitigation: two-week deprecation notice and opt-in feature flags (owner: DevEx)
Compliance/legal hold on model data prevents rotation - mitigation: pre-approved rotation lanes and escalation path (owner: Legal & Security)
rollout_cadence: Canary steps: 1% for 6 hours, 5% for 24 hours, 25% for 48 hours, 100% after 72 hours of green checks
Emergency fast-track: 0->100% allowed only for security fixes with exec approval and SRE on-call (requires post-mortem)
Weekly release window on Tuesdays 09:00-12:00 PT reserved for non-urgent model rotations
Model variant labeling convention enforced to make rollback deterministic (owner: Runtime)
eval_gates: Automated regression tests must pass on 100% of smoke prompt set and show <1.5% metric drift for primary biz metrics
Latency P95 must not increase > 20ms compared to baseline for more than two consecutive canary steps
Cost-per-token increase must be flagged if > 10% and require explicit PM sign-off to proceed
False-positive safety triggers >0.5% require manual QA review before further rollout
